scope: Source-only peer review of 520589c8 and 00f3ef31 for EXT-D-0087; no native browser run in this lane

A_runtime.reason: No hosted development artifact or browser execution was performed by this reviewer. Runtime readiness requires the separately owned native run.

evidence: The test chooses themes through the shared CDP trusted-pointer driver, observes the Settings control and alert in the rendered panel, and reads matrx.settings.v1 through chrome.storage.local.get.

The rejected-write case requires a dark UI selection, previously persisted system value, visible save error and Retry save button, plus one intercepted storage call. The retry then requires dark storage and reload hydration.

The overlap case holds the first Chrome storage write, chooses a second value, requires no second write before release, then requires two writes, the latest stored value, and the latest value after reload.

Hosted routing requires a CI development artifact; the importer verifies GitHub run/artifact metadata and native evidence, while this test checks the imported path, status, receipt, source ancestry, manifest version and tree hash.
limitations: The one-shot storage interception depends on chrome.storage.local.set being assignable in the actual Chrome extension context; installStorageFault checks assignment, so a mismatch fails closed during the native run.
The test proves save, error, retry and ordered persistence behavior for Theme. It is not a census of all Settings controls.
